$schema-note: Every card in Enjeu. 105 cards, poker size 63x88mm.
check:   null (always lands) | sure 75% | even 50% | hard 25% | wild 15%
bet:     life cards staked, each worth 25
element: fire | water | earth | wind | null
A skill's element decides whether it collects the +25 affinity and
biome bonuses. That is what makes five cards with one statline into
five different cards without printing a word on any of them.
class:   null, or the one class permitted to take this card
'name' never appears on the card. The glyph is the name; the player says it
tools/lint_cards.py checks this file against the balance ladder in
docs/BALANCE.md. Run it after editing anything here.

efficiency_bands.$note: Expected damage per life card bet. A new card must land in its tier's band.

attack.name: Bubble
attack.$note: Costs an action, not a card. Betting a card would be a trap: guarding with a Ready card is already free, so paying one to absorb 25 is strictly worse than guarding. Spending an ACTION makes it the mirror of Strike, attack for 25 or prevent 25, and it is the only attack card that is worth anything under Rage, where nothing can be guarded.

attack.name: Run
attack.$note: Costs an action and no card, like Bubble, so the two sit on the same axis: Bubble absorbs a certain 25, Run gambles for the whole hit. It sets the same Hidden state the Forest biome grants, which is why there is one rule and not two. It is also the only card whose effect the player narrates rather than computes: you say where you ran and what you hid behind.

class.name: Knight
class.passive: Once per round, guard 25 damage without discarding a card.

class.name: Hunter
class.passive: Once per round, reroll one failed check.

class.name: Necromancer
class.passive: When a minion falls, take one of its life cards as a Ready life card of your own.

advantage.name: Cure
advantage.effect: Return 2 Broken life cards to Ready.

advantage.name: Ally
advantage.effect: Place a companion figure. It Strikes for 25 free at the start of each of your turns. The boss's Strike hits it instead of you and it has 50 defense. You may cover it.

advantage.name: Rune
advantage.effect: One check this level succeeds automatically. Declare it before rolling.

advantage.name: Relic
advantage.effect: Every attack you land this level deals +25.

boss.name: Minion
boss.note: Only appears as a summon, never fought alone. Its life IS two of the boss's own cards, so it is printed at the same 100 a boss card is worth.

boss_reaction.name: Brace
boss_reaction.effect: Deals no damage. Until the end of your next turn, halve all damage it takes, rounded down to the nearest 25.

boss_reaction.name: Summon
boss_reaction.effect: Moves 2 of its life cards under a new figure. With 2 or fewer cards left, or 3 minions already, it Strikes instead.

boss_reaction.name: Roar
boss_reaction.effect: Deals its Damage. Your next check is one step harder.

biome.name: Village
biome.rule: You start the level with 1 extra Ready life card.

biome.name: Castle
biome.rule: The boss acts twice on round 1.

life.name: Boss
life.$note: Twenty, because the level 5 boss is 20 cards of 100 and that is the most ever on the table at once. It was 10 while a boss card's value changed per level; making every card 100 is what pushed the count up, and a wall of 20 that shrinks is the point rather than the cost.

mode.name: Second Wind
mode.effect: Optional. When you would go Down, come back instead. The first time each level is free. After that, roll: the check climbs one step every time you use it, Sure then Even then Hard then Wild, and stays Wild. Come back with 2 Broken cards returned to Ready. Fail the roll and the level ends as normal.
mode.$note: The gentle-mode card, added 2026-08-27 so a child does not lose a 15 minute level to one bad round. It is deliberately NOT in the Advantage deck: a safety net you might never draw is not a safety net. Put it in play or leave it in the box.

aid.name: Dice Bridge
aid.content: The four-step ladder and every die's target number. See docs/DICE-BRIDGE.md.

aid.name: Turn Order
aid.content: Recover, Act (3), Minions strike, Boss acts.

aid.name: Boss Reactions
aid.content: The d6 the boss rolls every round: 1 Brace, 2-3 Strike, 4 Summon, 5 Roar, 6 Ruin. A boss card may override a row.
aid.$note: Added 2026-08-27 with the second playtest. The rows are NOT written on this card: it draws boss_reaction below, so the printed aid cannot drift from the rule the engine reads.

aid.name: Damage Track
aid.content: A running total in four 25s, plus a box for a die that counts hundreds. Stand a brick on the total; past 100 the brick starts again and the die turns up one. See RULES.md section 7, Keeping count.
aid.$note: Added 2026-08-27. A counter, not a rule: it changes no number in the rulebook, and a player who prefers to take cards off the boss's pile never needs it.

element_cycle.$note: Each element beats the one it points at: +25 damage on every landed attack. No penalty for a bad matchup.
